correctness_confidence.basis: All printed primal weight tables (w_A, u_mon, u_ex), infinite-support dual cancellations, strict-slack mode localization checks at n=613..614, (20,3) collision arithmetic, and K_{n-1} equalizing flow identities verify independently in exact integer and rational arithmetic, supported by constructive Lean 4.35.0 formalizations.

novelty.basis: Settles four open problems and conjectures from Rossi (arXiv:2611.34537v1): discovers exact rational primal tables and tight infinite-support LP-dual barriers (including 257935/357572 via a single split constraint), gives a renewal-free proof of n_0=614, upgrades exact Sperner flows to n<=25, and proves a sharp NMP dichotomy.

reproducibility.basis: All primal weight tables, dual multipliers, collision witnesses, and closed-form K_{n-1} flows are printed explicitly for direct independent verification; minor deduction because the staged src directory holds README pointers to the external Lean 4 and Python verifier files rather than full inline code.

rigor.basis: Proofs avoid floating-point heuristics entirely, handle arbitrary and infinite-support tables in the dual barriers, treat boundary strictness rigorously for n>=30 and n>=37, and back core algebraic theorems with zero-sorry, zero-Classical.choice Lean 4.35.0 proofs.

significance.basis: Contracts the certified unverified Hall window by 21.65x (236x on the upper gap above 1/(2 ln 2)), establishes the exact intrinsic limits of Rossi local linear weight-table method, proves the Sperner property of OP_n up to n=25, and clarifies NMP behavior for Open Question 2.

summary: This manuscript resolves four concrete open problems and uncertified gaps from Rossi (arXiv:2611.34537v1) on Hall matching, mode localization, and the normalized matching property (NMP) of the permutohedron face lattice OP_n. Theorem 1 provides explicit all-integer primal weight tables (supports S = 8 and S = 10) shrinking the open Hall window by 21.65x to [(75n - 104)/104, (257935n + 99637)/357572] and proves matching finite-support LP-dual identities valid across all weight tables of arbitrary (even infinite) support, establishing 75/104, 233/323, and 257935/357572 as exact barriers of Rossi linear local weight tables. Theorem 2 gives an elementary proof of Rossi conjectured sharp mode threshold n_0 = 614 using strict-slack primal inequalities plus exact integer recurrence checks to n = 1164, and certifies the Sperner property for all n <= 25 via exact integer Dinic max-flows on the (S_n x C_2)-folded quotient. Theorem 3 settles key regimes of Open Question 2 via a Bonferroni NMP disproof for fixed j >= 2 and sublinear j = o(n / ln n), an exact child-collision explanation at (20, 3), and a closed-form equalizing flow on K_{n-1} proving NMP at j = n - 2 for all n >= 3. Independent checks confirm the printed weight tables, dual cancellations, mode threshold, and K_{n-1} load equalities.
strengths: Exact infinite-support LP-dual impossibility barriers (5-pair dual for 75/104 without superadditivity, 8-constraint dual for 233/323 under monotonicity, and 16-constraint dual using a single (1,8,1) -> (1,4,4,1) split for 257935/357572) paired with explicit all-integer primal tables.
Elementary, renewal-free proof of Rossi conjectured sharp threshold n_0 = 614 via strict-slack boundary bounds entering the window by n = 1164 and exact integer recurrence verification.

Zero-float exact integer Dinic max-flow certification on the reversal-folded (S_n x C_2)-quotient covering all ten window pairs through n = 25, upgrading rigorous Sperner verification from n <= 14 to n <= 25.

Clean NMP dichotomy combining a constructive Bonferroni bound for fixed and sublinear j, an explicit balanced-orbit collision witness at (20, 3), and an exact K_{n-1} quotient flow proving NMP at j = n - 2 for all n >= 3, supported by constructive Lean 4.35.0 proofs.
weaknesses: By design (and as proved in Theorem 1(b)), linear local weight tables leave an irreducible open window of width 1835/9296872 * n around n/(2 ln 2), so Hall condition and Spernerness for n >= 26 remain open.
For Open Question 2, NMP remains unresolved in the intermediate linear regime (such as fixed fractions c*n or j = n - k with fixed k >= 3) between the sublinear Bonferroni failure zone and j = n - 2.

The staged artifact directory includes README pointers to the external Lean 4 and Python verifier files rather than embedding the full verification source code directly inside the staged src bundle, though all primal tables and dual multipliers are printed explicitly in the paper.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact rational identification 257935/357572 and infinite-support 16-constraint LP-dual barrier using a single split (1,8,1) -> (1,4,4,1) for Rossi condition (i).
Renewal-free combinatorial proof of the sharp mode localization threshold n_0 = 614 using strict-slack weight-table inequalities plus exact integer recurrence verification.

Closed-form strictly positive equalizing flow on the K_{n-1} quotient proving universal NMP at j = n - 2 for all n >= 3, paired with the (20, 3) orbit-collision explanation and Bonferroni sublinear NMP disproof.
